paragraphs: The unqualified Rabbi Yose ben Zevida: there were two amoraim in the West, Rabbi Yose bar Avin and Rabbi Yose bar Zevida. They dispute in Berakhot, chapter 3, 22a and 33b, and Bammeh Madlikin 21b. Rabbi Yose bar Zavda: they dispute at the end of HaMatznia. Sukkah 37b, end, Rabbi Yose bar Zevila is a scribal error. Menachot 70b: Zavda. Tanchuma, Behaalotekha: Rabbi Yosef bar Zevida. Rabbi Abba HaKohen bar Pappa brought the matter before him. Rav Gaza and Rav Yosef.
